choices.help: The creator's default and the settings of its measurements: the release's bit349 manifest (K3 with K4 where it counts most, about 3.49 bits a routed weight), four requests at once sharing a 2,097,152-token KV pool, requests up to 262,144 tokens.
choices.label: Speed

choices.help: Eight requests at once sharing the 2,097,152-token KV pool, one request up to 1,048,576 tokens, and context-parallel KV (GR8_CP=1, experimental upstream). Decode at short context and prefill are a little slower. The creator measured 8.7-9.1 GiB free a box.
choices.label: Long context

choices.help: The release's K4 width (the widest), four requests at once sharing a 262,208-token KV pool, requests up to 262,144 tokens. The creator measured 9.4-9.6 GiB free a box.
choices.label: Quality

options.help: What to prioritize (the creator's TUNE). It sets the width manifest, the number of requests that decode at once, the KV pool and the longest request.
options.label: Priority
options.name: tune

choices.help: A request alone drafts with DFlash2 (the creator's default). The drafter is converted for this rank on the first start.
choices.label: DFlash2

choices.help: The checkpoint's MTP head only; the DFlash2 files are still downloaded as part of the recipe's model closure but unused.
choices.label: MTP only

options.help: Whether a request that runs alone drafts with IncoAI's DFlash2 drafter (CC BY-NC-ND 4.0, non-commercial: licence information only, nothing here enforces it) or with the checkpoint's MTP head only (the creator's DFLASH).
options.label: Speculative drafter
options.name: dflash

choices.help: Image input on (the creator's default): inline data: URLs, up to 16 images a request.
choices.label: Images

choices.help: No vision tower; about 1.6 GiB less memory a box.
choices.label: Text only

options.help: Whether each box loads GLM's vision tower (about 1.6 GiB of memory a box) so the API takes images (the creator's GR8_GLM53F_VISION).
options.label: Image input
options.name: vision

choices.help: The loader reads the release's files as they are (the creator's default).
choices.label: Off

choices.help: The first start writes the copies (the creator's prepare step), later starts read them.
choices.label: On

options.help: Dense per-rank copies of each box's expert ranges, written once to the writable cache and read by the loader in place of the release's sparse files (the creator's GR8_LOAD_COMPACT with GR8_LOAD_MERGE_KB=1). The creator measured a faster switch into the recipe on VARIANT=k4 (about 25-27 s against 33-34 s from GLM-5.3); the bit349 default was not measured. Needs about 73 GiB of disk a box.
options.label: Compact expert copies
options.name: compact
